title: Serapis
summary: Raleigh names Serapis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Serapis, also called Seraphis, the god with whom Thulis consulted, and vpon whom Sethon may haue called. He is named, as Nesroch was. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
